g.text: Enterprise Commerce Platform — Production Deployment (Docker Compose on two VMs)
Single failure domain. data-01 has no replica, so
and VM-level recovery, not on redundancy.
Recorded as a Negative consequence in ADR-0028.
The Scheduler is a first-class trigger, not a human
caller (P5) -- but it must fire once, not once per
replica. Only one ecp-api runs the `scheduler` profile.
See ADR-0028 and Deployment Diagram section 6.
All six roles enter through one REST API.
Authorisation is applied server-side at the
application boundary, never by a client. (P16)
